description: Check up to 25 NEW mission-test configs at once without saving them. Takes `drafts`: an array of objects, each with the same fields as draftMissionTestConfig. Returns `results`, one per draft in the same order, each exactly what draftMissionTestConfig returns for it: the config as it would be stored and `problems` (invalid fields, a phone number the dial policy blocks, a caller persona that no longer exists). An item that is not an object gets the problem "Each draft must be an object." Nothing is saved or changed, so it is safe to call repeatedly. Use when: you have several tests to check, for example rows read from a sheet with getImportRows. Saving is a separate step the user takes in the app.

drafts.description:
Up to 25 new mission test configs, each the same shape as the create body. An item
that is not an object is answered with a problem rather than refused.

name: draftMissionTestConfigBatch

outputSchema.description: The answer to a batch of drafts. Nothing is saved.

results.description:
One result per draft, in the order sent. Each is exactly what
`POST /testing/mission-test-configs/draft` answers for that draft.

config.description: The config as it would be stored. Empty for a draft that is not an object.

field.description: The field the problem is about. Absent when the draft is not an object.

message.example: Each draft must be an object.

title: Draft Mission Test Configs in a Batch
